birds.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the attached original 5x5 numbered label-border design sheet. design 13, third row third column: extract ONLY the pair of two small birds perched together near the upper-left corner, preserving their slightly tilted poses and tiny feet. Include the tiny leaf next to them if touching the bird cluster. Remove the straight rectangular border and perch line. Faithfully extract and clean up this original illustration, preserving its original silhouette, proportions, expressive details and black ink line style; do not redesign it. Deliver ONE isolated high-resolution transparent PNG with clean antialiased black strokes, tightly framed with a small even transparent margin. Remove all text, numbers, unrelated art and every bit of the label frame. All white background, including white interior regions of the line drawing, must become genuinely transparent. No baseline, surrounding box, gray background, checkerboard pixels, color, shadows or extra objects.
